name: Deutsche Pfandbriefbank AG
summary: Deutsche Pfandbriefbank AG provides commercial real estate and public investment finance. It operates through Real Estate Finance and Non-Core segments. The Real Estate Finance segment provides financing for professional property investors, which includes national and international property companies, institutional investors, property funds, and medium-sized companies, as well as regionally oriented customers to finance properties comprising office buildings, residential properties, retail and logistics properties, and business hotels.
